title: LifelyMC
description: ✦ Bring Minecraft to life with immersive and breathtaking visuals - optimized to run on anything.
body:
![Logo 0.2 update](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a162f670a8c6b107d59d9d70b3c5ed7ecc7a34d5.png)

**Enhance your Minecraft visuals with no performance comprimizes!**

LifelyMC is a Minecraft modpack that aims to provide enhanced visuals and QoL changes to the game without affecting the performance, and is completely client-based!

![Update 0.2 - Enhanced atmosphere](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/415eded0aee886fe835e1d3bc3d0c1f9ca5e04a1.png)
This picture is of the 0.2 update, running on default settings. 100-80 FPS on Geforce mx150, i5 8th gen, CachyOS(Linux)

## **✦ Key Features ✨**

**✦ Beautiful Visuals 🎨**
- An all new revamped UI for a more modern experience
- Better player model features with enhanced animations and more alive hands
- Enhanced atmosphere providing better skies, weather, particles and more!
- Shader support with optional built-in optimized shaders included

**✦ Great Optimization 🚀**
- Runs smoothly on lower-end PCs with cutting-edge performance mods
- Tested hundreds of times for the best experience
- All visual changes are powered by the most optimized mods and the power of recourcepacks 

**✦ Unlimited Render Distance 🌍**
- LOD rendering technology for seeing miles ahead provided by Distant Horizons
- Zero performance impact on render distance
- Allows for rendering all pastly generated chunks

**✦ Quality of Life 🎮**
- Improved third-person camera system
- Immersive HUD that renders only what's important at the moment
- Works on any server with it's client-based environment
- Hassle-free world hosting and voice chat system for playing with friends
- And more features like better screenshots, zoom and Jade

## **✦ Perfect For 🎯**

- Players with lower-end PCs seeking shaders-like visuals
- Those wanting QoL features without server restrictions
- Anyone looking for an immersive, polished Minecraft experience

## **✦ Disclaimer ⚠️**

Take a look at the settings and keybinds as there are a few important ones that you may want to change.
Important keybinds to remember:

- R - Used to zoom into far away objects. pair with the scroll wheel to zoom in and out
- U - Used to show all hud elements with no restrictions
- C - Used to control your voice chat system
- MB4 - Used to speak to other players (While held down)
- MB5 - Used to whisper to other nearby players (While held down)

## **✦ Future Plans 🔮**

- LifelyMC will receive "Flavor" packs that are always in sync with LMC but add more content at the expence of not running as fast and not being client-sided
- A safer and better environment is to be created by replacing the controversial "Essential mod" with better alternatives like found on the Vital modpack made to replace essential mod
- A redesign to the default UI resourcepack "Unique Dark Refined" to allow for better button tiling for the big main menu buttons
- An update to move the pack from 1.21.4 to 26.0 with the new version numbering system provided by mojang
- A questing system that includes different vanilla quests to achieve in game for a more entertaining playthrough
- A discord server for this pack
